integrity: Complete self-contained proof and independently executable finite exact checker are supplied. Finite computation is not a proof of asymptotics. No independent external validation or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to equal-rate random-order dimer parking on a finite open path; lattice-subsequence Poisson extreme, not a continuous centering or a theorem about simultaneous augmentation. Earlier two-point probability is prior art; inaccessible Page (1959) and broader multisite formulae are historical-priority risks.
title: Geometric vacancy chains and a Poisson extreme in discrete dimer parking
